title: Sex-by-exercise-angina interaction: a cross-hospital test of incremental coronary-disease prediction
abstract: Adding female-code × exercise-angina to flexible additive conventional measures changed external Brier score from 0.203571 to 0.203576. Baseline-minus-augmented gain was -0.000006 (1000 source-refit/target patient-bootstrap 95% interval -0.011957 to 0.004475). This estimates performance of one representation,not a causal sex effect or clinical utility. Hungarian development n=293;Cleveland external evaluation n=303. Separate hospital cohorts provide limited transfer evidence,not untouched confirmation because both have been extensively reused. AI-authored and author-self-checked;not independent peer review.
